from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

with sync_playwright() as playwright:
    browser = playwright.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://localhost:9222/")
    page = browser.contexts[0].pages[0]

    # Navigate to the "Find Owners" section
    page.click("text=Find Owners")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Search for an owner with last name "Cooper"
    page.fill("input[name='lastName']", "Cooper")
    page.click("button:has-text('Find')")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Verify that the application tells me that none such owner exists
    assert "No owners found" in page.content() or "no owner" in page.content().lower()

    # Navigate to the "Add Owners" section
    page.click("text=Add Owners")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Add a person with first name "Angelina" and last name "Cooper"
    page.fill("input[name='firstName']", "Angelina")
    page.fill("input[name='lastName']", "Cooper")
    page.fill("input[name='address']", "357 Second Street")
    page.fill("input[name='city']", "Chicago")
    page.fill("input[name='phone']", "6095366426")
    page.click("button:has-text('Add')")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Navigate to the "Find Owners" section
    page.click("text=Find Owners")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Search for an owner with last name "Cooper"
    page.fill("input[name='lastName']", "Cooper")
    page.click("button:has-text('Find')")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Verify that the application shows the owner "Angelina Cooper"
    assert "Angelina Cooper" in page.content()

    print(page.url)
    print(page.content())
```
